sageh.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Sage GL History' tab — read fresh every run per SKILL.md §2c; baked payload is only the fallback (never splice null). R35: optional disc ($, GL-negative) + gross series from the Discount % column. R37: optional nrMgn / cbMgn / wtyMgn series — the Non-Rev / Callback / Warranty Margin columns, dollars exactly as the Summary card's Margin row (negative = loss; blank → 0; all three to BOTH trades or to neither). The R36 nrEro/cbEro/wtyEro keys are RETIRED — no Excel column ever carried them. The Trends margin section hides when a payload lacks the keys

june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block. R41 changes FLAG CLASSIFICATION only — verified on the June exports vs R40: every summary key, every per-job money figure, P&L, dept card and Trends byte-identical; only the flag partition moves. Flagged-job counts legitimately DROP at R41 (June rebase: 293 → 171; Aug 1–3 live rebase: 48 → 7). Re-baseline the review queue, not the margin.

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.
notes: R41 (2026-08-04, per Stephen): NO-PAY and membership comm-over are no longer flags. (1) NO-PAY (zero pay lines on a $1,000+ revenue job) is cost-maturity timing — pay posts late and eventually lands — so it becomes an info-only field (job.noPay) with a dashed NO-PAY (info) chip and a muted ·no-pay marker beside the job number; never a flag, never reviewed. Above-plan pay still flags via COM-OVER; materials via PURCH-CAP. (2) COM-OVER pills (Jobs grid + Review Desk) now carry the overage: +$ above assumed plan and % of job revenue. (3) MEM COM-OVER split: when a COM-OVER's ENTIRE overage is explained by commission ServiceTitan paid on the job's membership tasks — memberships are non-commissionable by policy (techs get the $20 spiff on adjustments instead) and ST's payment is clawed back later — the job leaves `flags` for job.memOver: dashed MEM COM-OVER info chip, blue MEM-COM pill with the overage, no Approve/Watch, excluded from the FLAGS count, the Review Desk queue and the flag-age ledger (snap.js reads flags only). Classification: overage ≤ MAXCOMB (max combined tier, 12%) × job.memRev + $1, where memRev = positive invoice items whose name/code matches /sadie|member/ — captured in parseDisc for CLASSIFICATION ONLY; the commission pay base still excludes exactly the sadie items, so assumed COM, comUsed, labor and all P&L math are untouched (actual COM still overrides assumed). memRev FALLBACK: when RAW predates R41 (no memRev key — old saved copies, reused nightly payloads), the engine falls back to memRev = sadieRev, June-verified identical (every June membership item is sadie-worded). Summary gains memOverN/memOverDelta; Reconciliation splits real vs membership-only COM-OVER. Verified 2026-08-04: (a) jsdom A/B vs R40 on the June exports, goals=null — 3,902 jobs · $6,087,636 · GM 55.3% identical; all pre-existing summary keys identical in all 3 scopes (only additions memOverN/memOverDelta); per-job money identical; NEG-GM/LOW-GM/PURCH-CAP sets identical; COM-OVER partitions exactly 190 = 62 real + 128 membership-only (+$1,524 of $12,982 overage); NO-PAY 7 → 7 info; RAW identical modulo memRev/builtAt; sumCards/deptBody/P&L/Trends innerHTML byte-identical per scope; recon differs only in the commission line; gates 6/6 through frozen build.js; UI smoke green (chips 171/128/7/62, $/% on pills, no review buttons on mem-only rows, desk basis 171, memRev survives the saved-copy round trip). (b) jsdom A/B on TODAY'S live data (2026-08-04 nightly payloads re-spliced verbatim into R41): window 08/01–08/03 · 327 jobs · $517,989 · GM 56.5% — all summary keys identical, partition exact (COM-OVER 8 = 2 real + 6 membership-only +$29; NO-PAY 38 → 38 info; flagged 48 → 7), fallback memRev=sadieRev confirmed, handoff panel intact, zero engine errors. Header rev stamp fixed (R40 had left it at R39 — both stamps now R41). snap.js untouched (reads the engine's own flags list); its informational engine:'R40' literal is stale — cosmetic only. Manifest note: plaintext_chars is the JS String.length (UTF-16 units) measure, consistent with R34–R40; the 9-char delta vs a Python code-point count is the 9 astral glyphs in the engine.

mem.source: Yearly Goals.xlsx 'Margin Variables' tab — 'Other Revenue' block (Membership row: Revenue $ + Purchases $, branch monthly totals)
mem.split: 94% HVAC / 6% Plumbing, applied at ingest into PP_GOALS[trade].mem={rev,cost}
mem.behavior: MTD = monthly x calendar elapsedFrac; pace carries the full monthly figure exactly; cost lands in Purchases; all margins/% re-base to TOTAL revenue; mem absent/invalid → renders exactly R37

r39.caps: service-side 480 min/job, install 720 min/job; CB/WT worked entirely by an install crew inherit the install cap
r39.time_source: Job Costing 'Start of Working Time' / 'End of Working Time' x crew count from 'Assigned Technicians'; bucket median backfills the ~2% of jobs with no usable stamps
r39.rate: scope GP (and CP) split between service and install by share of job-attributed margin, divided by that side's man-minutes; lost minutes priced by the side of the tech who logged them
r39.caveat: opportunity cost at current productivity - not recoverable cash

r40.attribution: by trade, never by service manager - SMs help sell the job and do not review
r40.token_scope: fine-grained Contents read+write on the private repo ONLY - verified: write to the public pages repo returns 403
r40.aging_caveats: capped=true ages are floors (rendered >=Nd); cost-maturity inflates 0-2d flags; approval does NOT clear a flag in the data, so age alone cannot separate 'never looked at' from 'reviewed and accepted'
r40.gm_gate: ?gm=1 latches pp_gm in that browser - a visibility choice, NOT a security boundary

r41.mem_classification: job.memOver = comOver AND memRev>0 AND (actualCOM-assumedCOM) <= 12% x memRev + $1; memRev = positive invoice items matching /sadie|member/ (name or code), classification only — the pay base still excludes exactly the sadie items; memRev falls back to sadieRev when RAW predates R41
r41.no_pay: job.noPay = rev>=1000 AND zero COM/COMUT/BON/hourly — info field + dashed chip, never a flag
r41.ledger_rebase: first R41 nightly: flagged count drops (June rebase 293→171; Aug 1–3 rebase 48→7) because membership-only comm-overs and NO-PAY leave the flag set — ledger entries for those jobs stop updating (last_seen freezes); intended re-baseline, not data loss
r41.raw_compat: RAW.disc.byJob[*].memRev is the one new serialized key; R40-era saved copies classify via the sadieRev fallback — only a non-sadie membership wording (none observed in June) would be missed until the file is re-parsed
